name: virtualSecondScreen
desc: Single-screen devices: a second-screen layout shown as a panel of its own (swipe in from the edge / hotkey). */

name: virtualSecondScreenOpen
desc: The virtual second screen is shown now. */

name: secondScreenWallpaper
desc: Separate wallpapers: "" = the same as the main screen, else the picture's file name. */

name: heroTilesRows
desc: ---- Update 158: Hero tiles (StyleHeroTiles.kt, Settings › Home › Layout options) ---- Update 158, Hero tiles: rows of tiles under the big picture (1 or 2). */

name: heroTilesSize
desc: Update 158, Hero tiles: tile size, % of a row's height (smaller: more tiles across). */

name: heroTilesSpacing
desc: Batch 520 (K1): Hero tiles — room between the tiles, % of the standard gap (100 = as before; tile size stays its own). */

name: heroTilesDock
desc: Update 158, Hero tiles: the app dock at the bottom in the middle. */

name: heroTilesDockApps
desc: Update 158, Hero tiles: the dock's own apps (package names, comma separated); empty = Files, Browser, Store, System settings. */

name: heroTilesPale
desc: Update 158, Hero tiles: a pale backdrop with white tile frames (off: the theme's background). */

name: heroTilesStatusBar
desc: Update 158, Hero tiles: the status bar along the top too (off: the picture's own status pill). */

name: crateSpin
desc: ---- Update 158: Record crate (StyleRecordCrate.kt, Settings › Home › Layout options) ---- Update 158, Record crate: the record half out of the sleeve turns slowly (never while the home screen rests). */

name: cardsFan
desc: ---- Update 158: Card binder (StyleCardBinder.kt, Settings › Home › Layout options) ---- Update 158, Card binder: how far each card of the hand turns from the next (degrees; 0 = a flat row). */ Update 158: default 5, a step the slider's D-pad (steps of 5: 0, 5, 10, 15) can come back to.

name: cardsSheen
desc: Update 158, Card binder: a rainbow sheen sweeps once across the card you land on (never with Lite effects). */

name: cardsAPlays
desc: Update 158, Card binder: A starts the game straight away (off: A opens the game's window, as on other layouts). Popup-first (owner, 12 Nov): off by default - A opens the game's window on every layout that has one. Same key: a choice someone saved (on) is kept; only the unset default changes.

name: pqBgAnim
desc: Update 202, Pocket Quest: the scenery moves (drifting clouds, motes, bubbles); off: a still picture. */

name: pqParallax
desc: Update 202, Pocket Quest: how far the scenery's layers shift as you move along the games, % (0 = none). */

name: pqMedia
desc: (Update 295, Toni: "use the cartridge look as default on Pocket Quest": Cartridges & discs, whatever look the other layouts use — a new key, so everyone gets it once; Your game look and Cover art stay as choices.)

name: pqSounds
desc: Update 202, Pocket Quest: its own synthesized square-wave blips for moving around the menu (off: Voltcap's sounds). */

name: pqReducedMotion
desc: Update 202, Pocket Quest: reduced motion — no tilt, parallax, drifting or launch flash; changes are quick fades. */

name: pqTilt
desc: Update 202, Pocket Quest: the big picture of the game you're on leans gently in 3D. */

name: pqBumpers
desc: Update 202, Pocket Quest: L1 / R1 switch the console (off: they do what they do everywhere else). Update 204: off by default — on, R1 couldn't open the quick settings (the R1 panel) on this layout. A new key, so everyone gets the new default once; turning it on again is kept.

name: pqAPlays
desc: Update 202, Pocket Quest: A starts the game (off: A opens the game window, as on the other layouts). Popup-first (owner, 12 Nov): off by default; same key, so a saved choice is kept.

name: quickMenuInGame
desc: ---- Quick Menu while in a game ----

name: stageReaction
desc: Update 200, Lyrics stage: how hard the effects and the background answer the bass, in %. */

name: stageBgBlur
desc: Update 200, Lyrics stage: blur of the cover behind everything (0 = sharp). */

name: stageBgBright
desc: Update 200, Lyrics stage: brightness of that background, in %. */

name: stageFps
desc: Update 200, Lyrics stage: the effects' frame rate cap. */

name: stageIdleAfter
desc: Update 200, Lyrics stage: seconds after a pause before the stage goes idle. */

name: stageIdlePicture
desc: Update 200, Lyrics stage: the picture shown while idle (a content:// address), "" = none. */

name: stageUiScale
desc: Update 200, Lyrics stage: interface size, in %. */

name: stageLyricOffsetMs
desc: Update 200, Lyrics stage: lyric timing for every song, in ms (+ = the words come earlier). */
